ratified_by: ADR 0033 (layer model: domain prefixes + deployment classes)
ADR 0029 (AI Practices/Sessions boundary, with acceptance addendum)
ADR 0037 (Libre IA Design System 2.0 stack-wide visual contract)

layers.definition: User-facing workflows under functional libre-ai slugs; owns UX, product state, domain models and publication gates.
Tokens, UI primitives, accessibility, i18n UI, native bindings; also the agents' UI-production capability (tokens-only rule). Never owns actor/tenant authorization.
Agent orchestration, planning, handoff evaluation, execution coordination, and the factory's own public proof surfaces. Never ships in product binaries.
Inspection, security audit, and stack-evaluation tooling serving two or more domains. Never ships in product binaries.
Shared services and contracts linkable in product binaries (ingestion, memory, artifacts, distribution). One contract, two clients: product runtimes and agents.

web_shell.evidence: libre-ai/proof-kit/labs/dioxus ADR 0001 (2026-07-03): wasm 386 KiB gzip vs 450 budget, e2e 22 specs x 4 engines, HttpOnly session proven, a11y/token gates green

component_library.name: dioxus-primitives (Dioxus Components)
component_library.styling: headless/unstyled, WAI-ARIA; all appearance via Portal tokens (tokens-only)
component_library.crates_io_follow_up: un-pin to a semver range when a real (non-0.0.0) release exists on crates.io (lab friction F-006)

design_system.name: Libre IA Design System
design_system.palette: black, white, neutral grays and Vert Libre #22C55E as the only accent
design_system.typography: self-hosted Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans
design_system.distribution: generated CSS, Swift and Kotlin with SHA-256 manifest; no runtime network fetch
design_system.exceptions: raw benchmark evidence stays immutable; CLI-only repositories have no visual surface

native_delivery: Dioxus-first Android/iOS WebView shells with direct native API access; Portal owns adaptive UI and native integration contracts; SwiftUI/Compose remain escape hatches until separately justified
desktop: Dioxus desktop is the preferred shell, experimental per OS until Wrench proves WebView availability, sandboxing, install/update/rollback, accessibility and size budgets
static_publication: Dioxus SSG for ecosystem products (ADR 0032 s3); Astro remains permitted tooling outside ecosystem products
identity_ownership: Gear identity primitives + shared product workspace contract; Portal excluded (ADR 0028)

go: Rust service: Tokio, Axum, SQLx-ready, tracing (ids-only)
Dioxus 0.7.9 across web/PWA, SSR/SSG, fullstack, desktop, Android and iOS; support is claimed per target only after Wrench evidence
DB security gate whenever PostgreSQL is used (libre-ai/proof-kit/db-inspect)
conditional_go: PostgreSQL + SQLx - only when durable persistence is required
OIDC/Keycloak + Biscuit - only for organizational or multi-tenant rights
Clever Cloud/SQL/Cellar and Clever AI through portable adapters after operational approval (ADR 0043)
spike_local: Dioxus desktop/mobile target evidence until each OS passes its Wrench matrix
document worker: isolated, networkless, strict advisory gate
wait: Redis / persisted queues - until a product slice proves fanout/retry durability
Duplicate SwiftUI/Compose product UIs - escape hatch only after explicit product evidence
no_go: Paid provisioning or live providers without a separate human operation approval
Direct model-provider fallback or provider SDK in core truth
Mandatory US-hyperscaler or proprietary SaaS dependencies in core truth
narrowed: Astro static publication: permitted outside ecosystem products only; ecosystem products publish via Dioxus SSG (ADR 0032 s3)

dod_chain: libre-ai/agent-factory planning-only handoff with evidence refs

wave.name: 2026-07 clean-room capability wave
wave.posture: big-bang: nothing is in service, blocking is acceptable, per-repo gates stay green at every merge

compromises.subject: named EU hosted compute, SQL, object storage and AI boundaries
bounded specialized runtimes outside the Rust core
